name: ClimaxBarAtChannelLine

shortCondition: haveHiLine && el_ge(high[0], hiNow) && el_gt(close[0], open[0]) && el_ge(close[0] - open[0], bodyFraction * (high[0] - low[0])) && el_ge(high[0] - low[0], largeBarAtrMultiple * atrVal)
